name: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for The Washington Trust Company, of Westerly that provides various banking and financial services to individuals and businesses. The company operates in two segments, Banking and Wealth Management Services.
